text: My dear Mr. Bennet,
speaker: Mrs. Bennet

text: have you heard that Netherfield Park is let at last?
speaker: Mrs. Bennet

text: But it is,
speaker: Mrs. Bennet

text: for Mrs. Long has just been here, and she told me all about it.
speaker: Mrs. Bennet

text: Do you not want to know who has taken it?
speaker: Mrs. Bennet

text: You want to tell me, and I have no objection to hearing it.
speaker: Mr. Bennet

text: Why, my dear, you must know, Mrs. Long says that Netherfield is taken by a young man of large fortune
speaker: Mrs. Bennet

text: What is his name?
speaker: Mr. Bennet

text: Bingley.
speaker: Mrs. Bennet

text: Is he married or single?
speaker: Mr. Bennet

text: Oh! Single, my dear, to be sure!
speaker: Mrs. Bennet

text: How so? How can it affect them?
speaker: Mr. Bennet

text: My dear Mr. Bennet,
speaker: Mrs. Bennet

text: how can you be so tiresome!
speaker: Mrs. Bennet

text: Is that his design in settling here?
speaker: Mr. Bennet

text: Design! Nonsense, how can you talk so!
speaker: Mrs. Bennet

text: I see no occasion for that.
speaker: Mr. Bennet

text: My dear, you flatter me.
speaker: Mrs. Bennet

text: In such cases, a woman has not often much beauty to think of.
speaker: Mr. Bennet

text: But, my dear, you must indeed go and see Mr. Bingley when he comes into the neighbourhood.
speaker: Mrs. Bennet

text: It is more than I engage for, I assure you.
speaker: Mr. Bennet

text: But consider your daughters.
speaker: Mrs. Bennet

text: You are over-scrupulous, surely.
speaker: Mr. Bennet

text: I desire you will do no such thing.
speaker: Mrs. Bennet

text: They have none of them much to recommend them,
speaker: Mr. Bennet

text: they are all silly and ignorant like other girls; but Lizzy has something more of quickness than her sisters.
speaker: Mr. Bennet

text: Mr. Bennet, how can you abuse your own children in such a way?
speaker: Mrs. Bennet

text: You mistake me, my dear.
speaker: Mr. Bennet

text: Ah, you do not know what I suffer.
speaker: Mrs. Bennet

text: But I hope you will get over it
speaker: Mr. Bennet

text: It will be no use to us, if twenty such should come
speaker: Mrs. Bennet

text: Depend upon it, my dear, that when there are twenty, I will visit them all.
speaker: Mr. Bennet
